Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds linked to document CHEMBL4420072. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4420072' and require canonical_smiles to be present. Return rows ordered by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
